Visit note | 2025-10-06 10:00 AM | Dr. Fahmida Yasmin, ENT | Patient: Ibrahim Patwary, 61, male. Mr. Patwary returns for review regarding his ongoing allergic symptoms, reporting that his condition is much worse with dust exposure and that he frequently suffers from itchy eyes. He notes that these problems have become significantly worse since road construction began near his home in Gulshan. He works as a garment factory worker in a dusty environment, which aggravates his symptoms. He has no significant comorbid medical conditions and denies fever, facial pain, or loss of smell. On examination, his vital signs show about 3 sneezing fits a day, blood pressure of 132/85 mmHg, pulse rate of 92 bpm, and a weight of 59 kg. Nasal turbinates appear pale and boggy with clear secretions, and his throat is clear. Assessment: Allergic rhinitis. Plan: a prescription was issued to help manage his flare-up. He was advised to avoid dust as much as possible, wear a protective face mask when cleaning, and wash his bedding weekly in hot water. Follow-up is scheduled in 1 month to assess treatment response.

Visit note | 2025-10-06 10:30 AM | Dr. Nasrin Sultana, Gastroenterology | Patient: Shathi Alam, 53, female. Mrs. Alam attends for a follow-up review, stating she continues to experience cramping belly pain and persistent bloating, which she notes are noticeably worse with psychological stress. She mentions her symptoms began after a severe bout of food poisoning in Farmgate. She works as a construction worker. She reports no other major medical conditions and denies significant weight loss, fever, or bleeding. Examination reveals a pain score 4/10, with mild lower abdominal tenderness upon palpation, along with a blood pressure of 131/75 mmHg, pulse of 92 bpm, and weight of 59 kg. Assessment: Irritable bowel syndrome. Plan: a prescription was issued. She was advised to eat regular meals, keep a detailed food diary, and reduce her intake of tea, fizzy drinks, and beans. Follow-up in 6 weeks with the food diary.

Visit note | 2025-10-06 10:30 AM | Dr. Tahmina Begum, Dermatology | Patient: Sukumar Nath, 19, male.
